mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card (id, name, cate, annual, pre, corp) VALUES (card_seq.nextval, #{name}, #{cate}, #{annual}, #{pre}, #{corp})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM card_table_jpa ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE card_table_jpa SET name=#{name}, cate=#{cate}, annual=#{annual}, pre=#{pre}, corp=#{corp}, discontinue=#{discontinue}, sharestate=#{sharestate} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO card_brand_table_jpa b USING ( SELECT #{id} AS id, #{visa} AS visa, #{master} AS master, #{bc} AS bc, #{amex} AS amex FROM dual ) src ON (b.id = src.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET b.visa = src.visa, b.master = src.master, b.bc = src.bc, b.amex = src.amex WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, visa, master, bc, amex) VALUES (src.id, src.visa, src.master, src.bc, src.amex)

MERGE INTO card_benefit_table_jpa bf USING ( SELECT #{id} AS id, #{fuel} AS fuel, #{comm} AS comm, #{shop} AS shop, #{food} AS food, #{cafe} AS cafe FROM dual ) src ON (bf.id = src.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET bf.fuel = src.fuel, bf.comm = src.comm, bf.shop = src.shop, bf.food = src.food, bf.cafe = src.cafe WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, fuel, comm, shop, food, cafe) VALUES (src.id, src.fuel, src.comm, src.shop, src.food, src.cafe)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM card_table_jpa WHERE name = #{name}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, LISTAGG(benefit_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY benefit_name) AS benefits FROM ( SELECT id, CASE WHEN fuel = 1 THEN '주유' END AS benefit_name FROM card_benefit_table_jpa UNION ALL SELECT id, CASE WHEN comm = 1 THEN '통신' END FROM card_benefit_table_jpa UNION ALL SELECT id, CASE WHEN shop = 1 THEN '쇼핑' END FROM card_benefit_table_jpa UNION ALL SELECT id, CASE WHEN food = 1 THEN '푸드' END FROM card_benefit_table_jpa UNION ALL SELECT id, CASE WHEN cafe = 1 THEN '카페' END FROM card_benefit_table_jpa ) GROUP BY id ) result_query JOIN card_table_jpa c ON result_query.id = c.id WHERE (REGEXP_LIKE(result_query.benefits, #{cardFindBrand}) AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(result_query.benefits, '%'))
SELECT * FROM card_table_jpa WHERE sharestate = 1 order by id desc

SELECT * FROM CARD_TABLE_JPA ct LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, LISTAGG(benefit_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY benefit_name) AS benefits FROM ( SELECT id, '주유' AS benefit_name FROM CARD_BENEFIT_TABLE_JPA WHERE fuel = 1 UNION ALL SELECT id, '통신' FROM CARD_BENEFIT_TABLE_JPA WHERE comm = 1 UNION ALL SELECT id, '쇼핑' FROM CARD_BENEFIT_TABLE_JPA WHERE shop = 1 UNION ALL SELECT id, '푸드' FROM CARD_BENEFIT_TABLE_JPA WHERE food = 1 UNION ALL SELECT id, '카페' FROM CARD_BENEFIT_TABLE_JPA WHERE cafe = 1 ) GROUP BY id ) sqt ON ct.id = sqt.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, LISTAGG(brand_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY brand_name) AS brands FROM ( SELECT id, 'VISA' AS brand_name FROM CARD_BRAND_TABLE_JPA WHERE visa = 1 UNION ALL SELECT id, 'MASTER' AS brand_name FROM CARD_BRAND_TABLE_JPA WHERE master = 1 UNION ALL SELECT id, 'BC' AS brand_name FROM CARD_BRAND_TABLE_JPA WHERE bc = 1 UNION ALL SELECT id, 'AMEX' AS brand_name FROM CARD_BRAND_TABLE_JPA WHERE amex = 1 ) GROUP BY id ) sqt2 ON ct.id = sqt2.id WHERE ct.id = #{id} ORDER BY ct.id DESC
SELECT * FROM CARD_TABLE_SCRAP ORDER BY "id" DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO CARD_TABLE_GBRAND_SCRAP b USING ( SELECT #{id} AS id, #{visa} AS visa, #{master} AS master, #{bc} AS bc, #{amex} AS amex FROM dual ) src ON (b."id" = src.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET b."visa" = src.visa, b."master" = src.master, b."bc" = src.bc, b."amex" = src.amex WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ("id", "visa", "master", "bc", "amex") VALUES (src.id, src.visa, src.master, src.bc, src.amex)

MERGE INTO CARD_TABLE_BENEFIT_SCRAP bf USING ( SELECT #{id} AS id, #{fuel} AS fuel, #{comm} AS comm, #{shop} AS shop, #{food} AS food, #{cafe} AS cafe FROM dual ) src ON (bf."id" = src.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET bf."fuel" = src.fuel, bf."comm" = src.comm, bf."shop" = src.shop, bf."food" = src.food, bf."cafe" = src.cafe WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ("id", "fuel", "comm", "shop", "food", "cafe") VALUES (src.id, src.fuel, src.comm, src.shop, src.food, src.cafe)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CARD_TABLE_SCRAP WHERE "sharestate" = 1 ORDER BY "id" desc

SELECT * FROM CARD_TABLE_SCRAP cts LEFT JOIN ( SELECT "id", LISTAGG(benefit_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY benefit_name) AS benefits FROM ( SELECT "id", '주유' AS benefit_name FROM CARD_TABLE_BENEFIT_SCRAP WHERE "fuel" = 1 UNION ALL SELECT "id", '통신' FROM CARD_TABLE_BENEFIT_SCRAP WHERE "comm" = 1 UNION ALL SELECT "id", '쇼핑' FROM CARD_TABLE_BENEFIT_SCRAP WHERE "shop" = 1 UNION ALL SELECT "id", '푸드' FROM CARD_TABLE_BENEFIT_SCRAP WHERE "food" = 1 UNION ALL SELECT "id", '카페' FROM CARD_TABLE_BENEFIT_SCRAP WHERE "cafe" = 1 ) GROUP BY "id" ) sqt ON cts."id" = sqt."id" LEFT JOIN ( SELECT "id", LISTAGG(brand_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY brand_name) AS brands FROM ( SELECT "id", 'VISA' AS brand_name FROM CARD_TABLE_GBRAND_SCRAP WHERE "visa" = 1 UNION ALL SELECT "id", 'MASTER' AS brand_name FROM CARD_TABLE_GBRAND_SCRAP WHERE "master" = 1 UNION ALL SELECT "id", 'BC' AS brand_name FROM CARD_TABLE_GBRAND_SCRAP WHERE "bc" = 1 UNION ALL SELECT "id", 'AMEX' AS brand_name FROM CARD_TABLE_GBRAND_SCRAP WHERE "amex" = 1 ) GROUP BY "id" ) sqt2 ON cts."id" = sqt2."id" WHERE cts."id" = #{id}
